## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need for adding a loading spinner during page transitions in the Volto project. Currently, when users navigate through the site, it feels unresponsive since the browser doesn’t show any loading indication despite API requests happening in the background.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to implement a loading spinner that appears when navigating between pages, improving the user experience by visually indicating that content is loading. The suggestion is to replace the logo in the toolbar temporarily with this spinner.

## Helpful background
As noted, page transitions occur through API calls, which can make the site feel sluggish without visual feedback. React Router is used for navigation, and integrating animations or spinners here would enhance perceived performance.

## Good first steps
1. Check the existing implementation of React Router in the Volto project.
2. Explore options for integrating a loading spinner when routes change.
3. Review the conversations in this issue for community insights and nuances. 
4. Consider testing the spinner across different areas to ensure it operates smoothly.
5. Feel free to ask for help if you’re unsure about any steps!
